about_the_game:
Welcome to Mech Assembler, a relaxing puzzle game inspired by model kit building (Gunpla). You'll experience the tranquility of building a model kit, then painting it with Spry, using masking tape to avoid painting unwanted areas.

Cut, assemble, paint, and customize your models! Build mechs, waifus, armor, figures, and much more.

Each time you complete a model kit, you earn points and in-game currency, which you can use to refill paint cans and unlock in-game items.

All models and parts have been carefully designed for a relaxing experience.
